chatgptPrompt: Create a YouTube Shorts / TikTok cover, 9:16 (1080x1920). Keep the focal point and the text inside the centre safe area. Subject: a big bright Moon over a silver-lit beach, the figure in a long shadow. Text: "6.5× the light" in a clean geometric sans (Lexend style), white with one teal word (#4FE3C6). Palette: indigo night (#0B0F2A), teal glow. Avoid arrows, circles, faces, logos, watermarks, anything that looks like a real NASA photo. It must read as a painted illustration. Scientific accuracy: this is a thought experiment, the real Moon is not coming closer.
